verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Stripe publishes a per-resource API reference, such as the Billing Meter Events page under docs.stripe.com/api, and machine-readable docs exist via llms.txt and .md pages. Nothing shows that reference is interactive or offers runnable examples, and the OpenAPI spec probes all returned 404. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive API explorer, runnable or try-it-now examples, a discoverable OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration.
